# LokTube 1.6.2

- Fix the **theater-mode header remaining visible after switching back to a playing video tab**. A tab clicked with the mouse no longer leaves the header stuck over the video.
- Automatically retract the theater header after **2.5 seconds of inactivity**, including when the pointer remains stationary over the header/tab strip; move the pointer to the top edge to reveal it again.
- Preserve normal access to search, keyboard navigation, focusable controls, and open menus/dialogs. Keep the short leave-delay so the header does not flicker when navigating across controls.
- Add desktop regression coverage for tab clicks, switching between watch and other tabs, and retaining search focus through the inactivity timeout.

Fix: [PR #24](https://github.com/lokal-music/loktube/pull/24).

Previous release: v1.6.1 includes audible tab indicators and YouTube TV-code casting. v1.6.2 adds only this theater-mode usability fix.
